project.project_summary: [26.4 / April Fools] - Modpack that mainly tries to support snapshots with maximum performance, including Sodium. This includes minimal QoL mods.

version.changelog:
- Updated [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) and (C2ME)[https://modrinth.com/mod/c2me-fabric]
- Removed [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium), [Better Block Entities](), [SSPB]() [ImmediatelyFast](https://modrinth.com/mod/ImmediatelyFast), [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/Lithium), [ModernFix-mVUS](https://modrinth.com/mod/modernfix-mvus), and [Fast Noise](https://modrinth.com/mod/zfastnoise)
